spans.s: यत् vi. 1Ā (pres. यतते) 1. To endeavour, to strive after, to be eager for, प्रियतमा यतमानमपाहरत् R.ix.7; 2. to exert oneself, to persevere, यततो ह्यपि कौंतेय पुरुषस्य विपश्चितः (the Par. is epic) Bg.ii.60; 3. to be cautious or watchful.With प्र-, to strive.With सम्-, to struggle.

यत् Caus. (यातयति-ते) 1. to requite, to recompense; 2. to prepare; 3. to torture, to distress; 4. to despise; 5. to encourage.With निस्-, 1. to restore, M.xi.164; 2. to requite, e.g. रामलक्ष्मणयोर्वैरं स्वयं निर्यातयामि वै.With वि-, to punish.
यत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Bound; 2. restrained, curbed, controlled, (pp. of यम् q.v.).
यत (II) n. The stirring of an elephant by means of the rider’s feet.
यत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Bound; 2. restrained, curbed, controlled, (pp. of यम् q.v.).
यात (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Gone, walked; 2. gone away, departed, (pp. of या q.v.).
यात (II) n. 1. Going, motion; 2. the past time.
यात (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Gone, walked; 2. gone away, departed, (pp. of या q.v.).
यत-आत्मन् a. self-restrained, curbing the senses, तपसे यतात्मा K.S.i.54.
यत-आहार a. abstemious.
यत-इंद्रिय a. of subdued passion, chaste, pure.
यत-चित्त, -मानस a. subdued in mind.
यत-चित्त, -मानस a. subdued in mind.
यत-वाच् a. observing silence, reticent. (Also वाग्यत.)
यत-व्रत a. observing vows, keeping to engagements.
यतन n. Effort, endeavour.
यातन n. 1. Requital, retaliation, recompense; 2. revenge, vengeance.
यातना f. 1. Requital, recompense; 2. acute pain, torment, agony; 3. punishment inflicted by Yama.
यतम a. (f. मा; n. मत्) Who or which (out of many.)
यतम a. (f. मा; n. मत्) Who or which (out of many.)
यतम a. (f. मा; n. मत्) Who or which (out of many.)
यतर a. (f. रा; n. रत्) Which of the two.
यतर a. (f. रा; n. रत्) Which of the two.
यतर a. (f. रा; n. रत्) Which of the two.

यतस् ind. 1. From where, from which place, from which quarter, यतश्च भयमाशंकेत्तते । विस्तारयेद्बलम् M.vii.188; 2. where, अर्घ्यमर्घ्यमितिवादिनं नृपं सोऽनवेक्ष्य भरताग्रश्चो यतः R.xi.69; 3. from which time forward; 4. because, since, whereas, उवाच चैनं परमार्थतो हरं न वेत्सि नूनं यत एवमात्थ माम् K.S.v.75, R.viii.76; 5. from whom, यतस्त्वया ज्ञानमशेषमाप्तम् R.v.4.(यतस्ततस् 1. from any place whatsoever; 2. from any person; 3. on this side and that, on all sides, मुहुरंगानि यतस्ततः क्षिपंती Bh.V.ii.26; यतोयतस् 1. from whatever place; 2. from any person; 3. wherever, Bg.vi.26.)
यतोभव a. produced from which.
यतोमूल a. originating in or from which.
यति (I) pron. (declined only in the plural; nom. and acc. यति) How many, as many.
यति (II) f. 1. Restraint, check; 2. guidance; 3. stopping, rest; 4. a pause in music, a cæsura (in prosody), (यतिर्जिह्वेष्टविश्रामस्थानं कविभिरुच्यते Ch.M.i.); 5. a widow.
यति (III) m. One who has abandoned the world, an ascetic, a twice-born in the fourth order of life, यतिपार्थिवलिंगधारिणौ R.viii.16.
यतित a. (f. ता) Attempted, tried, striven after, endeavoured.
यतित a. (f. ता) Attempted, tried, striven after, endeavoured.
यतिन् m. An ascetic.
यतिनी f. A widow.
यत्न m. 1. Effort, exertion, diligence, zeal, महान् हि यत्नस्तव देवदारौ R.ii.56; 2. labour, work, pains, अस्मिन् द्वये रूपविधानयत्नः पत्युः प्रजानां वितथोऽभविष्यत् R.vii.14, K.S.vii.66.

यत्र ind. 1. In which place, where, K.S.i.7, 9, 10, 11, 14; 2. when, यत्र काले त्वनावृत्तिमावृत्तिं चैव योगिनः Bg.viii.23; 3. whereas, because, as that, since.With कुत्र or क्व, it means- 1. in whatever place or time, wheresoever; 2. whensoever; 3. hither and thither.

यात्रा f. 1. Going, journey, R.xviii.16; 2. a march or expedition of an army, मार्गशीर्षे शुभे मासि यायाद् यात्रां महीपतिः M.vii.182; 3. a pilgrimage; 4. a company of pilgrims; 5. a festival, a festive procession, a fair, कालप्रियनाथस्य यात्राप्रसंगेन M.M.i.; 6. a road; 7. support of life, livelihood, subsistence, शरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिध्येदकर्मणः Bg.iii.8; 8. passing away (as time); 9. intercourse, दायाद्यस्य प्रदानं च यात्रा चैव हि लौकिकी M.xi.184; 10. way, means; 11. a vehicle in general; 12. custom, practice, एषोदिता लोकयात्रा नित्यं स्त्रीपुंसयोः शुभा M.ix.25.
यत्र-स्थ a. dwelling in which place, of which place.
यात-याम, -यामन् a. 1. stale, used, spoiled; 2. raw, half-ripe, half-cooked, यातयामं गतरसं भोजनं तामसप्रियम् Bg.xvii.10; 3. exhausted, aged.
यात-याम, -यामन् a. 1. stale, used, spoiled; 2. raw, half-ripe, half-cooked, यातयामं गतरसं भोजनं तामसप्रियम् Bg.xvii.10; 3. exhausted, aged.
यातु (I) m. 1. A traveller, a wayfarer; 2. wind; 3. time.
यातु (II) m.n. An evil spirit, a demon.
यातु-धान m. an evil spirit, a demon.
यातृ f. A husband’s brother’s wife, R.xii.45.
यात्रिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Relating to a campaign or a journey; 2. requisite for the support of life; 3. customary, usual.
यात्रिक (II) n. 1. A march, an expedition; 2. provisions, supplies.
यात्रिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Relating to a campaign or a journey; 2. requisite for the support of life; 3. customary, usual.
